career_ladder.note: Gram Panchayat Adhikari (under the Panchayati Raj Department) and Gram Vikas Adhikari (under the Rural Development Department) serve as the key administrative and executive functionaries at the village panchayat level across Uttar Pradesh. They execute rural development programs, manage village panchayat funds, maintain birth/death and family registers, and coordinate social security pensions.

exam_scheme.note: Candidates are shortlisted through their normalized UPSSSC PET score, followed by a single-stage Main Written Examination. For Advt. No. 01-Exam/2023 (Panchayati Raj), UPSSSC notified an updated subject-specific exam scheme of 100 marks focusing on rural governance, Panchayati Raj systems, computer applications, and Uttar Pradesh general knowledge. Negative marking is 0.25 (1/4th) per wrong answer.

financial_package.note: Gram Panchayat Adhikari and Gram Vikas Adhikari posts carry Pay Level 3 (Pay Band ₹5,200–₹20,200 with Grade Pay ₹2,000) under the Uttar Pradesh Revised Pay Rules, 2016.
financial_package.pay_source_label: UP Panchayati Raj Department & UP Revised Pay Rules 2016 Level 3
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 3 entry basic pay of ₹21,700 at 58% DA (effective 01.07.2025), HRA (₹1,800 to ₹3,600 based on posting classification), rural travel conveyance allowance, net of 10% NPS deduction (₹3,429) and group insurance scheme deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually per UP Finance Department orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) based on block / tehsil classification
Conveyance and village travel allowance for field inspection duties
Medical reimbursement under UP Government Servants Medical Rules
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% matching employer contribution
Official mobile data / communication allowance for digital panchayat portal operations
